papers.relied_on: merged-conclusion.md line 109 cites it as a 2026 early-pregnancy TyG meta-analysis that reports associations only.
papers.full_text_shows: 23 observational studies (220,985 subjects); high versus low early-pregnancy TyG gave pooled OR 2.51 (2.18-2.90, I2 80%, 16 studies, categorical) for GDM. Subgroup effects were mainly in Asian cohorts, no international cutoff exists, heterogeneity was high, and quality was rated with NOS only. The authors nonetheless conclude TyG can be used for early diagnosis and that monitoring it enables targeted interventions, which association-only data do not show.
papers.quote: significantly positively correlated with the occurrence of GDM, GH, PE, PTB, LGA, and macrosomia
papers.key_numbers: GDM categorical OR 2.51 (2.18-2.90), I2 80%, 16 studies; continuous OR 5.33 (1.50-18.99), I2 96%, 2 studies; PE continuous OR 2.45 (1.07-5.61), 1 study; GDM Egger p=0.839; 23 studies, 220,985 subjects
papers.role_in_work: Supporting citation for an absence-of-decision-evidence statement
papers.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies, RevMan, NOS quality scoring, random effects

papers.relied_on: merged-conclusion.md line 35 and Corrections: HOMA-IR association with CVD survives adjustment for waist and lipids (OR 2.52 to 1.94) in San Antonio.
papers.full_text_shows: Numbers match the abstract. Population is 2,569 non-diabetic Mexican-American and non-Hispanic white adults followed 8 years with 187 events (mixed nonfatal and fatal CVD). Fully adjusted quintile 5 vs 1 OR 1.94 (1.05-3.59), P trend 0.02; the lower bound is close to 1, so survival after adjustment is borderline. Fasting insulin gave similar results and no significant interactions with ethnicity, sex, hypertension, dyslipidaemia, glucose tolerance or obesity.
papers.quote: only modestly reduced the magnitude of these associations
papers.key_numbers: 2,569 subjects, 187 events, 8 years; OR 2.52 (1.46-4.36) age/sex/ethnicity adjusted; OR 1.94 (1.05-3.59) fully adjusted
papers.role_in_work: Single-cohort evidence that fasting HOMA-IR associates with incident CVD beyond waist and lipids
papers.design: Prospective population cohort, logistic regression by quintile
papers.measure_type: Fasting-based (HOMA-IR and fasting insulin); 2-h glucose used only for glucose tolerance strata
papers.assay_or_platform: Fasting insulin after 12-14 h fast; assay details not checked
papers.quality_note: 2002 cohort; combined endpoint; wide interval; one cohort; association, not prediction or decision evidence

Four assays (Elecsys, Liaison, Beckman Ins-IRMA, Wallac) were specific to human insulin. Immulite was excluded for matrix problems. Text has accent garbling; numbers readable.
papers.quote: cross-reactivity values for insulin analogues or glargine metabolites ranged from 0% to 264%
papers.key_numbers: 16 assays; 5 analogues plus M1 and M2; 0-264%; 4 human-specific assays
papers.role_in_work: Analytical evidence that assay choice affects insulin-analogue detection in suspected factitious hypoglycaemia
papers.measure_type: Insulin immunoassay (random measure; analytic, not post-load)
papers.assay_or_platform: 16 immunoassays (Abbott, Beckman, CIS Bio, DiaSorin, PerkinElmer, Roche, Siemens, Tosoh, others)
papers.quality_note: In vitro, spiked in albumin or serum matrix; analogues partly supplied by manufacturers; funding statement not checked; no clinical diagnostic accuracy

papers.relied_on: usecases-verified.md line 127: Atellica 92-121% for five analogues.

LC-MS/MS detected glargine partially (68%) and most other analogues not at all. Authors note glargine converts in serum and that insulin to C-peptide ratios differ between platforms.
papers.quote: The limitation of the study is that this is an in vitro study only.

papers.measure_type: Random insulin and C-peptide (analytic; not post-load)

claim_issues.where: merged-conclusion.md line 109 (early-pregnancy IR measures for GDM)
claim_issues.issue: The TyG meta-analysis is a non-insulin surrogate, which the text does not say; the full text shows no discrimination, no cutoff, high heterogeneity, and an authors' claim of diagnostic use that the data do not support.
claim_issues.proposed_wording: a 2026 meta-analysis of early-pregnancy fasting TyG, a non-insulin surrogate (PMID 42110441, DOI 10.3389/fmed.2026.1811358; full text: 23 observational studies, mostly Asian, GDM OR 2.51 (2.18-2.90), I2 80%, no standard cutoff), reports associations only, although its authors suggest use for early diagnosis

claim_issues.where: merged-conclusion.md line 35 and Corrections line 123 (San Antonio)
claim_issues.issue: The fully adjusted interval is 1.05-3.59, close to 1; the cohort is non-diabetic, 187 combined events, fasting-based. Full text slightly lowers confidence that the adjusted result is firm.
claim_issues.proposed_wording: It survives adjustment for waist and lipids in one cohort of 2,569 non-diabetic adults with 187 combined events (fasting HOMA-IR, San Antonio, PMID 12087016, full text: OR 2.52 (1.46-4.36) to 1.94 (1.05-3.59)); the adjusted interval comes close to 1.

claim_issues.issue: RR 1.03 is per U/mL of fasting insulin on 4 RCTs and 741 women, not the 8-RCT or 907-woman set. The abstract-only note that unit and assay were unstated is resolved (fasting insulin, U/mL). A HOMA-IR interaction of 1.14 (1.03-1.25) exists; letrozole vs clomiphene shows no clear interaction. Analyses are exploratory.
claim_issues.proposed_wording: PCOS IPD meta-analysis (31647106, full text) | baseline fasting insulin, per U/mL | exploratory interaction for clomiphene plus metformin vs clomiphene, live birth RR 1.03 (1.01-1.06), 4 RCTs, 741 women; HOMA-IR 1.14 (1.03-1.25); no cutoff given; letrozole vs clomiphene fasting-insulin interaction 1.01 (1.00-1.02)

claim_issues.issue: Both assay studies are in vitro and spiked; read level can be upgraded from abstract to full text. The Atellica figure is recovery at one spike concentration (10 ng/mL).
claim_issues.proposed_wording: Heurtault 2014 (full text): in vitro spiking of 16 immunoassays, cross-reactivity 0-264% depending on assay and concentration; Li 2025 (full text): Atellica recovery 92-121% at a single 10 ng/mL spike, in vitro only; LC-MS/MS 68% for glargine and little detection of other analogues.
